Part.Title: GENERAL PROVISIONS RELATING TO LICENSING OF DRIVERS OF VEHICLES

P1group.Title: Drivers of motor vehicles to have driving licences

P2para.Text: It is an offence under this Order for a person to drive on a road a motor vehicle of any class otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising him to drive a motor vehicle of that class.

It is an offence under this Order for a person to cause or permit another person to drive on a road a motor vehicle of any class otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising that other person to drive a motor vehicle of that class.
